name: idle-paws
description: A pixel pet (cat, dog or duck) that hangs out on your Claude window, plus a menu of your favourite web games to play while Claude works.
long_description: Idle Paws adds a pixel pet that walks, sleeps and plays fetch on top of Claude's input bar, and hops when a Claude Code session finishes. Right-click the pet for the console (pet controls and games); double-click it to play fetch. Add links to the games you like in the extension settings; Play opens them as a menu in the side browser pane. macOS only.

games.title: Games
games.description: Links to games you'd like to play while Claude works, opened in Claude's side browser pane. One per entry: a link (https://lichess.org/training) or a named link (Chess puzzles | https://lichess.org/training). Pick sites that work on a phone so they fit the pane. You can also add or remove games any time from the games menu (+ Add game) or by asking Claude.

tools.name: open_game
tools.description: Open your games menu in the browser pane

tools.name: add_game
tools.description: Add a game link to your games menu

tools.name: remove_game
tools.description: Remove a game from your games menu
